sections.name: 阅读理解
sections.note: 每题 2 分。阅读所给文章，从四个选项中选出最佳答案。

passage.title: A recycling scheme that worked
passage.text: Two years ago the university installed recycling bins in every dormitory. The first survey was disappointing: only a third of bottles reached the correct bin. Instead of adding more bins, the housing office tried something cheaper. It published a weekly chart in each building showing how much waste had been sorted correctly, and it asked the cleaners to leave one wrongly sorted bag beside the bin with a short note. Within a term the rate rose to nearly three quarters. The lesson is that people do not need more instructions; they need to see how they are doing compared with their neighbours.

sections.note: 本题 12 分。把划线句子译成汉语，要求准确、通顺。

sections.name: 写作
sections.note: 本题 12 分。按题目要求写一篇短文。

items.stem: Write an essay of about 150 words on the following topic: your university wants to increase the recycling rate in dormitories. Suggest one practical measure and explain why it should work.

answer.text: Instead of printing more instructions, the university should publish a weekly ranking of dormitory buildings by recycling rate. Each building would see its own figure and its position among neighbours. The measure is cheap, since the data are already collected when the waste is weighed, and it works on a well-documented principle: people adjust their behaviour when they can see how it compares with that of people around them. To avoid resentment, the ranking should praise improvement rather than shame the bottom building, and the top three could receive a small fund for a floor party. Visible progress, rather than another leaflet, is what changes habits.

explain.right: 先定三段骨架（描述—分析—结论），再把题目给出的信息逐条落进段落，最后检查字数与衔接词。
explain.wrong: 常见错误：只写「加强宣传」这类空泛建议，没有说明具体做法与生效机制。
